title: Wedding Seat
description: Anonymous, no-login wedding planning: create a project, add guests, auto-generate a seating plan.
summary: Anonymous, no-login wedding planning: create a project, add guests, auto-generate a seating plan.
offersHint: Anonymous, no-login wedding planning: create a project, add guests, auto-generate a seating plan. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mcp.wedding-seat.com/mcp

toolsPreview.name: create_wedding_project
toolsPreview.description: Create a new anonymous Wedding Seat project (no login). Returns a projectKey (your secret handle for all later calls) plus the workspace URL the couple opens in a browser. The projectKey is the ONLY way to access the project again — keep it.

toolsPreview.name: add_guests
toolsPreview.description: Add guests to a project (deduped by name+email). Provide the projectKey from create_wedding_project and a list of guests.

toolsPreview.name: generate_seating
toolsPreview.description: Auto-generate a reception seating plan: creates round tables and seats every guest with the constraint-aware solver (keeps must-sit-together groups together). Returns how many were seated and a link to the visual editor.

toolsPreview.name: get_project_summary
toolsPreview.description: Read the current state of a project: guest counts by RSVP status, seating tables/capacity, and budget totals. Read-only.

toolsPreview.name: list_culture_packs
toolsPreview.description: List the available wedding culture packs (key, English name, cluster, sides). Use a pack key as the `culture` argument to create_wedding_project. Grounding/read-only.

toolsPreview.name: list_tools
toolsPreview.description: List Wedding Seat's free planning tools (seating chart, guest list, budget, checklist, invitation wording) with their public URLs. Grounding/read-only.
